topography.project_purpose: Index Coop is an active decentralized asset management protocol focused on automated DeFi structured products, including leverage and yield strategies such as Smart Loops, alongside tokenized products built on SetToken infrastructure. Legacy index products remain part of the historical product set but should be distinguished from the current product focus on automated leverage and yield offerings.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Bankless GMI and Web3 DATA families are standalone SetTokens that likely rely on the shared infrastructure of the Index Coop family, such as the Controller, IntegrationRegistry, and issuance modules, for their management and lifecycle operations. The Index Coop family itself contains a diverse set of SetTokens and supporting contracts that provide governance, leverage strategies, and exchange issuance capabilities, forming the backbone for all product families.
